title: House of Rohl Presents Riobel Manifesto Bath Collection
summary: The House of Rohl is proud to introduce the Riobel Manifesto Collection
body_markdown:
### Contemporary Craft Meets Architectural Artistry


The House of Rohl is proud to introduce the[Riobel Manifesto Collection](https://houseofrohl.com/riobel/collections/manifesto/) , an unmistakable statement of purpose and permanence, informed by the structural lineage that shaped the emerging cityscapes of early 20th-century North America.


Defined by its signature groove, each piece exudes a clean, balanced beauty that reflects its origin story. Contemporary craft meets architectural artistry in no uncertain terms.


The collection is available in multiple finishes.
